headline: Sensex, Nifty surge over 1 pc as Trump announces Iran deal, Hormuz reopening
summary: Indian equities opened sharply higher Monday after US President Donald Trump announced that a deal with Iran had been finalised and the Strait of Hormuz would reopen.
why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty 50 are the main benchmark indices of Indian equities. India imports much of its crude oil, so Gulf shipping conditions matter for the economy.
why_moved: Trump's announcement of a finalised Iran deal and the Strait of Hormuz reopening reduced geopolitical and energy supply concerns for Indian markets.
